documents.text: mortgages at 12 percent annual interest, with maximum terms of 10 years. POSB was formed in 1904, as the "Post Office Saving Bank". In 1999 the People’s Own Savings Bank Act was established as a corporate body in accordance with the People’s Own Savings Bank of Zimbabwe Act. In 2001, the Zimbabwe Posts & Telecommunications Corporation (PTC) was split into four independent entities: (a) Net-One, an Internet service provider, (b) Tel-One, a voice communication service provider (land-line and celular) (c) Zimpost, a postal letter carrier and (d) POSB, a savings bank. The People's Own Savings Bank is 100 percent owned
